title: The kernel of a surjective etale ring map is idempotent and finitely generated
statement: Let $\varphi:A\to B$ be a surjective homomorphism of commutative rings such that $\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism], and let $I=\ker\varphi$. Then (1) $I$ is an idempotent ideal: $I^2=I$; (2) $I$ is a finitely generated ideal of $A$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 00U8 (lemma-surjective-flat-finitely-presented), first proof: '$I$ is finitely generated by Lemma 00F0 (lemma-finite-presentation-independent) since $\varphi$ is of finite presentation. Moreover, since $S$ is flat over $R$, tensoring the exact sequence $0\to I\to R\to S\to0$ over $R$ with $S$ gives $I/I^2=0$' (an etale ring map is flat and of finite presentation, Algebra Lemma 00U5 (lemma-etale))
